geometryProvenance: GL-D1-inspired adaptation; Xie Figure7 polygon not visually verified
apexConvention: Explicit additional gA=p flow at pA=J*c*cot(phi); constant perfect Cauchy strength and regular psi0. Positive apex plastic volume changes the constitutive response; not strict MC at all states or a fracture model.
apexCapBandPolicy: Preserve the old elastic screen. Analytic apex only when mean excess exceeds the EXISTING stressTolerance/(2*sin(phi)); equality and the entire remaining band delegate unchanged strict projection, including rejection.
apexMultiplierConvention: Separate lambdaA is the last accepted apex return's plastic volume multiplier, retained in its owned derived projection; a post-commit current-minus-committed zero does not mean no accumulated flow.
strengthReduction: Independent pre-reduced perfect Cauchy MC at SRF=1.6: c/F and atan(tan(phi)/F); explicit additional hydrostatic-apex gA=p volumetric flow, not unchanged strict MC or a verified unstable bound
